items.difficulty_reason: 62-line proof fully executed: reduce to local constancy on a quasi-compact open of the pseudo-catenary cover; decompose into finitely many irreducible components; expand dim via the spaces-level formula (external-carried content, named-pointer rank), make the relative-dimension term locally constant by the in-pool accepted semi-continuity lemma (2); reduce to equality of dimensions at crossing points of two components; construct the disjoint opens V, W with intersecting images in the irreducible |X|, write the two dimension equations, transfer the local constancy of the relative dimension across the connected union, and compare; the single-component case closes on the in-pool accepted constancy-of-dimension. No omissions.
